name: Flat Bedrock

vanilla_changes.change: Overworld/Nether floor collapsed to a flat layer (default thickness 1); Nether roof flat or removable; bedrock can be swapped for another block per dimension. The End is unchanged.

getting_started: Applies automatically in new chunks; already-explored terrain keeps vanilla bedrock.
editor_notes: Pack author's own mod (chimericdream). Needs Architectury and YACL. Config-overrides has no entry, so defaults are assumed.
summary: Replaces vanilla's jagged multi-layer bedrock with a flat layer: by default 1 block at the bottom of the world and a flat roof in the Nether. Only affects newly generated chunks.
